Madanu Emilya

Hyderabad, India | +91 7659020087 | madanuemilya@gmail.com

SUMMARY

Trade Settlements and Securities Operations professional with 5+ years of experience in Investment Banking and Capital Markets Operations, specializing in domestic and international trade settlements, settlement investigations, trade matching, fail management, reconciliation, custody operations, and client servicing. Experienced in handling Equities, Bonds, CDs, Treasuries, Agency Securities, MBS, Commercial Paper, and Municipal Securities across DTC, DTCC, CNS, FED Wire, Euroclear, and CREST markets. Strong experience in trade lifecycle management, settlement exception resolution, counterparty communication, risk controls, and meeting strict SLA and settlement deadlines.

EDUCATION

Master of Business Administration (MBA) – Finance

2021 – 2024

Jagruthi Degree & PG College Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA)

2017 – 2020

Sri Sai Raghavendra Junior College Intermediate

2016 – 2017

Divya Bala Vidyalayam High School SSC

2015

EXPERIENCE

Capital Market Associate | Client: Barclays ACCENTURE SOLUTIONS PVT. LTD.

April 2024 – May 2026

Managed end-to-end trade settlement operations across multiple international markets, including Germany,



Italy, Netherlands, France, Switzerland, DTC, Euroclear, and CREST. Investigated trade settlement failures, identified root causes, coordinated corrective actions, and followed up with agents, counterparties, and relevant internal teams through successful settlement.

Managed full and partial netting processes across multiple European markets. • Reviewed trade instructions, static data, settlement details, and matching status to identify discrepancies and initiate manual corrections where required.

Performed CREST market operations, including manual trade splits and settlement instruction processing. • Processed and managed settlement instructions using applications including Citi Direct, EasyWay, GOS, BONY, Euroclear, GLOSS, CREST, and DMW.

Managed client and counterparty queries relating to trade status, securities movements, settlement exceptions, and operational issues.

Processed SWIFT MT599 messages and supported manual settlement instructions across various markets. • Checked security positions using RTSR and coordinated with Middle Office for position coverage when trades



were short. Investigated unmatched and rejected trades, coordinated with agents to correct settlement formats, and ensured accurate re-instruction.

Performed daily reconciliation and break management, ensuring outstanding breaks were investigated and resolved within agreed timelines.

Prepared and reconciled month-end reports and attestations while maintaining operational accuracy and control standards.

Monitored daily fail reports, maintained standardized fail comments, and provided timely status updates to PBMO, trading desks, clients, and management.

• Managed daily workflow and ensured delivery against SLA, risk, and settlement deadlines.

• Supported root cause analysis for operational incidents and promoted timely escalation and resolution. • Assisted in training new joiners and supported knowledge transfer across settlement processes.

Investment Banking – Trade Settlements | Client: UBS COGNIZANT TECHNOLOGY SOLUTIONS

March 2021 – March 2024

Processed and settled domestic DTC trades across Equities, Bonds, Certificates of Deposit (CDs), and other capital market securities.

Managed trade settlement activities including broker-to-broker settlements, CNS fails, settlement exceptions,



and position-related issues. Investigated trade failures, identified settlement issues, and coordinated with internal teams, trading desks, purchase and sales teams, and counterparties for resolution.

Maintained high focus on $1MM+ fails, Municipal securities, and CD trades, ensuring timely resolution and settlement.

Processed NSCC and DTCC funding through wires for domestic market settlement activities. • Worked closely with Corporate Actions teams during voluntary and involuntary corporate events, including moving or closing fails where required.

Used Obligation Warehouse (OW) for advisories, CNS exits, and SmartTrack activities, including submission of buy-ins to counterparties.

Prepared and sent physical delivery tickets for trades settling through custody services and coordinated with agents and physical vault teams.

Checked short positions and coordinated movement of securities between depots to cover settlement shortages. Investigated and cleared cash and reconciliation breaks, including zero-age breaks and firm out-of-balance • issues.

Processed daily journal entries related to inter-book transfers and supported daily operational reporting. • Prepared and distributed risk reports and EOD reports to onshore teams. • Generated counterparty fail reports before market open and prioritized settlement exceptions to reduce fail exposure.

Supported SPO charges, including sending charges to counterparties and following up for timely receipt. • Worked under strict settlement deadlines and handled urgent operational and client queries within agreed SLAs.

FED SETTLEMENTS – UBS

Supported FED Wire settlement operations for eligible fixed-income transactions. • Worked with securities including Agency Securities, Mortgage-Backed Securities (MBS), Treasuries, Commercial Paper, and TVA Bonds.

Performed trade and fail confirmations with counterparties and supported FICC reporting and funding activities. Investigated daily reconciliation breaks received from the Asset Control team and coordinated resolution.

• Supported factor update processing and investigated money differences resulting from factor updates. • Monitored failing trades, followed up with counterparties, and ensured timely settlement or appropriate escalation.

Supported FICC and Page Center reporting, trade/fail confirmations, and daily settlement controls.

TECHNICAL SKILLS

Trade Settlements & Securities Operations DTC / DTCC Settlements Trade Matching & Pre-Matching Trade Fail Management Settlement Investigations & Exception Management Reconciliation & Cash Break Resolution CNS & Broker-to-Broker Settlements FED Wire Settlements Custody Operations Corporate Actions Support

Full & Partial Netting CREST Market Operations & Manual Splits Euroclear Settlements SWIFT Messaging – MT599 Counterparty & Client Management Risk Management & Operational Controls Short Position Management NSCC / DTCC Funding SLA & Deadline Management Root Cause Analysis & Escalation

SYSTEMS & APPLICATIONS

Settlement / Market Platforms: DTC, DTCC Portal, Settlement Web, CNS, CREST, Euroclear, FED Wire, FICC Applications / Tools: Citi Direct, EasyWay, GOS, BONY, GLOSS, DMW, RTSR, OW (Obligation Warehouse), SmartTrack, PRDB, Consult Works, RUMBA Messaging: SWIFT MT599

PRODUCTS / ASSET CLASSES

Equities | Bonds | Certificates of Deposit (CDs) | Treasuries | Agency Securities | Mortgage-Backed Securities (MBS) | Commercial Paper | Municipal Securities | TVA Bonds

KEY STRENGTHS

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills Excellent trade fail investigation and resolution capabilities Effective client, counterparty, and stakeholder communication Ability to manage multiple priorities under strict settlement deadlines Strong attention to detail and operational risk awareness Quick learner with adaptability across processes and applications Team collaboration, knowledge sharing, and new-joiner support
